source_of_truth: ouuut-v2 design-lock + live computed styles at 1440px, 2026-10-21. japan.ouuut.com must read as the same publication as ouuut.com.
style: Tokyo Expedition Magazine Editorial / ouuut family. Two themes only: sage (day) and dark (night). Zero structural lines.
theme_boot: localStorage pj-theme wins; otherwise sage 06:00-17:59, dark otherwise. No mono.

typography.serif: Instrument Serif 400 / Noto Serif JP 700 / Noto Serif SC 700
typography.sans: Geist 400-500 / Noto Sans JP 500 / Noto Sans SC 500

home.band: Six plates, three across, two rows; grid gap 16px. Two columns ≤1199px, one column ≤1000px (horizontal card), vertical card ≤640px.
home.plate_box: aspect-ratio 1000/332 at ≥641px (340 until the scales ledger moved under the band and the fold had to absorb it), and back to 1000/680 at ≤640px where the card turns vertical — every plate is a build-time SVG at viewBox 1000×760, centred, never stretched (preserveAspectRatio meet). The wide box ratio is deliberate: it letterboxes the plates to 42-46% of the box width (~110-120px of gutter per side) at ≥1200px, which is the price of six plates inside one screen, not an accident. The shipped labels inside those plates (.micro/.legend 22px, .ward 24px user units) render at 3.9-4.4px there, as they already did at 4-7px before this round.
home.preview_plates: weather and news have no feed yet: the foot reads「予告」/「预告」/「Soon」without the 開く arrow, the card is a div rather than an a, and hover neither lifts nor tints it.
home.h1: Ledger heading below the band (no longer the page lead): clamp(23px,2.2vw,31px) EN / clamp(22px,2vw,28px) JA·ZH, line-height 1.06 EN / 1.14 JA / 1.12 ZH; the ≤640px override is clamp(30px,8.2vw,42px) / clamp(28px,7.8vw,38px). px+v.w at every breakpoint, no rem: the cover must not grow when the browser's default font size is raised (a 20px root used to add 25px to the cover and push row 2 under the fold — found by the 2026-10-25 review), while every other text size on this page is already px.
home.scales: the ledger below the band, in HTML order: h1 (cover.title, 「六つの尺度」/ 六种尺度 / six scales) + closing line (cover.lede) on one row — two columns 1.15fr/.85fr, stacked ≤1000px — then an <ol> of six cells in the band's own order. Each cell is the plate's verb over the measure it covers (cover.scale.weather|quake|crime|cabinet|housing|news): 全国·47地点 / 列島·27年 / 東京·62区市町村 / 内閣·14 / 住宅·23区 / 各社·24時間. The verb repeats the plate head on purpose (that is what a legend is for); the measures are the only new copy. Six columns ≥1001px, three ≤1000px, two ≤640px. The ledger is text, not a second set of links, and ≤640px the h1 is the page's largest type again.
home.measured_2026_10_25: Cover, on the built artifact, ja/en/zh x root font 16px and 20px (every value byte-identical at both root sizes, measured). Two Chromium builds read 4-6px apart — this repo's managed Chromium vs ego-browser's Chromium 1200 with an imported profile — so hold to the envelope, not a single figure. 1920x945: band bottom 743-754px, the ledger's last row 921-931px, i.e. six plates AND all six scales above the fold with 14-23px of room. 1440x900: band bottom 743-753px (cards clear with 147-157px of room), the ledger's headline row ends at 850-858px and its list starts at 867-874px, so the row is visible and the six cells are cut by the fold. 1280x800: band bottom 723-733px, headline row ends 824-832px, list starts 841-848px. 1024x768: the band is TWO columns (three card rows, band bottom 1101-1108px) — one column starts at ≤1000px, per home.band; 768x900 and 390x844 are one column. At 1024 and below the page scrolls by design, which was already true before the ledger. Overflow 0, console errors 0, 6 cards / 4 links / 6 scale cells at every size. Waiting for document.fonts.ready moves these numbers by ~1px only. Earlier reading: 943px (ja, 16px root) held for that one case; a 20px root measured 974px, which is what moved the cover h1 to px+v.w.
home.removed_2026_10_25: the cover eyebrow line「JAPAN.OUUUT.COM · 2000—2026」(key cover.kicker) is gone from the cover.

notes: Homepage runs six prod-style plates, three across and two down, in this order: weather, quake, crime, cabinet, housing, news. The four chapter plates are links; the weather and news plates are previews (no live feed), so they carry「予告」instead of「開く」and are not links.
Charts use one signal hue per theme; no rainbow categorical palette.
Motion: grain, scroll progress, header scrolled, .rv reveal, theme view-transition. No custom cursor/particles.
